summary: Frontend regression test of cleaned-up Contact Detail screen. Verified hero/health/quick-actions/jessi-card/tabs/details-order/edit/composer/tabs for Bridger Demo-Units (sold) and Bud (expected non-sold). Core layout and interactions work; found minor missing testids and one potential regression around qa-sold-btn on Bud.

ui_bugs.issue: Only 4 QA buttons rendered (Text/Call/Record/Task). Spec expects 5 including gold qa-sold-btn for a not-yet-sold contact. Either Bud is inadvertently flagged sold in seed data OR the 'show Sold button when !sold' logic regressed.

testability_issues: Missing testids on header edit-flow buttons: contact-edit-button / contact-save-button / contact-cancel-button not present on DOM (Edit/Save/Cancel text buttons work but automation must fall back to text selectors).

The following documented testids are not queryable via document.querySelector on the DOM even though the underlying UI renders (likely React Native <View>/<Text> where data-testid attribute isn't forwarded by RN-Web): contact-hero, contact-name, contact-meta-line, hero-tags-strip, hero-add-tag-btn, contact-tab-bar, date-row-anniversary, anniversary-optin-switch, start-recording-btn, action-progress, contact-stats-row, campaign-row-N. This breaks automation hooks even though the feature works.

Working testids confirmed: contact-health-badge, quick-actions-row, qa-text-btn, qa-call-btn, qa-note-btn, qa-task-btn, qa-sold-btn (when shown), jessi-card, contact-ask-jessi-btn, intel-teaser, intel-teaser-expanded, intel-briefing-card, tab-details, tab-calls, tab-feed, date-row-sold, details-more-toggle, add-birthday-btn.
verified_pass: Hero shows name 'Bridger Demo-Units', gold vehicle line '2022 Toyota Supra', meta '2 day relationship', tags strip with 'Sold' + '+ Tag'. No cryptic tchs/msgs/clks in hero.
Health badge: single line 'Opportunity · Active now - recent engagement signal'.
Quick actions for sold contact: exactly 4 buttons [qa-text-btn, qa-call-btn, qa-note-btn, qa-task-btn]; no qa-email-btn, no qa-sold-btn.
qa-text-btn focuses composer textarea; qa-task-btn opens Add Task modal.

Jessi card is the only gold-bordered card above tabs. Ask button text 'Ask about Bridger'. Tapping intel-teaser expands intel-teaser-expanded and renders exactly 1 intel-briefing-card (with 'RELATIONSHIP INTEL' header) INSIDE the jessi card; collapsing returns count to 0. No second intel-briefing-card exists in Details tab.

Details tab is default active. Vertical order matches spec: PERSONAL INTELLIGENCE -> PURCHASE HISTORY (2022 Toyota Supra Sep 1 2026, 2022 Road Glide Jul 13 2026) -> IMPORTANT DATES (Add birthday, Date sold Sep 1 2026 with chevron, Anniversary text + card switch) -> VOICE MEMOS ('Record a voice memo') -> FOLLOW-UP CHECKLIST -> CAMPAIGNS (flat rows, 6 total) -> RELATIONSHIP stats -> MORE toggle.
date-row-sold tap opens 'Date sold Automation' sheet with Edit Date / Pause Auto-Card / Cancel.
details-more-toggle toggles 'Share Profile' visibility on tap.
Calls tab renders '0 calls / No calls yet' empty state; Feed tab renders Campaign Journey with 6 campaigns and search.
Edit mode header opens form (First Name Bridger, Last Name Demo-Units, Phone, Email, Vehicle, Employment) with Save/Cancel; Cancel returns to view with hero intact.
Composer shows SMS/Email switch, input, attachment icons, and round call button; switching visible in screenshots.
action_items: Confirm whether Bud is intentionally sold in seed data; if not, restore qa-sold-btn rendering for non-sold contacts.
Add data-testid attributes on the edit-mode header buttons: contact-edit-button, contact-save-button, contact-cancel-button.

Investigate why data-testid props on certain <View>/<Text> nodes in HeroSection, DetailsTab, and tab-bar wrapper aren't hitting the DOM on RN-Web. Consider using RN's testID prop (which RN-Web forwards to data-testid) instead of raw data-testid on <View>/<Text>, or ensure the intended element is a Pressable/div.
critical_code_review_comments: app/contact/[id].tsx is very large (>2700 lines); still could benefit from further modularization even though HeroSection/DetailsTab/JessiCard have been split out.
Mixed use of testID vs data-testid on RN components leads to unreliable DOM testability; standardize on testID prop for cross-platform consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contact detail cleanup verified for sold contact (Bridger Demo-Units id 6aa7425eefb7a2e43806c16e). Layout, jessi single-card pattern, intel expand/collapse, tab switching, date-sold sheet, more-toggle, edit mode, composer all work. Two follow-ups: (1) Bud (id 69a496841603573df5a41723) shows 4 QA buttons instead of 5 (missing qa-sold-btn) — verify seed status; (2) several testids not forwarded to DOM on RN-Web View/Text nodes.
rca of the issue: React Native Web forwards testID -> data-testid but doesn't always forward raw data-testid props on View/Text; hence some elements are invisible to automation. For the Bud QA regression, likely the sold check condition uses a broader flag than expected.
